extracted.name: Crispy Pan-Fried Salmon
extracted.description: This Crispy Pan-Fried Salmon is the ideal way to commemorate Father's Day, which demands something unique. This dish is surprisingly easy to prepare at home, but it seems restaurant-worthy with its gorgeously golden, crispy shell and soft, flaky core. One of those dishes that feels exceptional without requiring a lot of work is this Crispy Pan-Fried Salmon. It's the ideal dish to prepare for Father's Day or any family supper, with a soft, flaky core and a gorgeously golden, crispy exterior. The best aspect is that it can be made fast in a single pan, which makes it perfect for basic yet stunning recipes. The seasoned salmon fillets, which are delicately marinated before being covered in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, are the key to this recipe. Pan-frying keeps the salmon moist and delicate on the inside while producing a gorgeously crisp exterior. If the fillets are thick, finish them in a 350F (180°C) oven for 5 minutes after frying. A squeeze of fresh lemon and a sprinkle of herbs add the perfect finishing touch, while the salmon's rich flavour pairs wonderfully with roasted vegetables, mashed potatoes, rice, or a fresh salad. Whether you're cooking for Dad, your family, or just treating yourself, this dish delivers restaurant-style results right at home. #CookpadApron2026 #Happyfathersday
instruction_lines: Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and lemon juice.
In a bowl add flour and coat each fillet in flour.
Beat eggs in a bowl and dip the fillet into beaten eggs.
Combine breadcrumbs with Parmesan and parsley and press the fillet in the breadcrumbs until fully coated.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry salmon for about 3–4 minutes per side, until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels.
Cut the salmon into triangles. Serve with crinkle-cut fries and a dollop of creamy herb sauce and garnish with fresh mint.
